title: Effectiveness of the Numerous Educational Strategy Interventions Seeking to Increase the Water Consume in Child
brief_summary: The current project seeks to evaluate the effectiveness of numerous educational strategy interventions to increase the percentage of water consumed among early elementary school students over a 1-year period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy children
* Both girls and boys
* Children whose parents agree to participation in the study through verbal informed consent
* Children whose parents sign a privacy notice

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children who present with any pathology that interferes with the free consumption of water or with the proper execution of the study
* Children for whom it is not possible to obtain a baseline record of beverage consumption
